'''P2''' was a prototype astromech droid.<ref name="ITW" /> It shared its name with [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] [[P2-series astromech droid]].

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
P2 was depicted in the [[2004]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'', in a section focusing on locations from<ref name="ITW" /> the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> That section was written by [[James Luceno]] and illustrated by [[Richard Chasemore]] and [[Hans Jenssen]].<ref name="ITW" />
